risks.note: Gold and other precious-metal prices are influenced by global economic conditions, currency movements, interest rates, geopolitical developments and demand-supply dynamics; significant movements may affect customer demand, margins, inventory values and working-capital requirements.

Jewellery retail and manufacturing are inventory-intensive; rising gold prices increased the Company's inventory cost and working-capital requirements during the year, underscoring the importance of disciplined inventory planning.

The market includes national chains, regional players and established local jewellers; product design, customer service, pricing, trust and changing consumer preferences can influence demand and margins.

The Company's operations are centred in Rajkot and subject to laws governing jewellery business, taxation, consumer protection and hallmarking; this concentration means any adverse local development could have a more pronounced effect than on a more geographically diversified peer.
In an increasingly digitalised operating environment, cybersecurity threats pose a risk to data integrity, customer information and business continuity.

The Company adopted a more cautious stance in procurement, pricing and inventory planning during the year in view of heightened uncertainty in global markets arising from ongoing geopolitical tensions.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Gold and other precious-metal prices are influenced by global economic conditions, currency movements, interest rates, geopolitical developments and demand-supply dynamics; significant movements may affect customer demand, margins, inventory values and working-capital requirements.
- Jewellery retail and manufacturing are inventory-intensive; rising gold prices increased the Company's inventory cost and working-capital requirements during the year, underscoring the importance of disciplined inventory planning.
- The market includes national chains, regional players and established local jewellers; product design, customer service, pricing, trust and changing consumer preferences can influence demand and margins.
- The Company's operations are centred in Rajkot and subject to laws governing jewellery business, taxation, consumer protection and hallmarking; this concentration means any adverse local development could have a more pronounced effect than on a more geographically diversified peer.
- In an increasingly digitalised operating environment, cybersecurity threats pose a risk to data integrity, customer information and business continuity.
- The Company adopted a more cautious stance in procurement, pricing and inventory planning during the year in view of heightened uncertainty in global markets arising from ongoing geopolitical tensions.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continuing focus on profitable and sustainable growth, customer satisfaction, product quality, prudent inventory and working-capital management, operational efficiency and preservation of a strong financial position.
- Continued focus on employee capability, product knowledge, customer relationship management, operational discipline and a professional working environment.
- Evaluating opportunities for geographic expansion over time, with the immediate priority being to strengthen internal systems and operating processes before pursuing such expansion.
